title: Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index (June 2027), 10:00 a.m. ET
source: EST: the publisher's standing rule, restated on conference-board.org/topics/consumer-confidence fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200) -- "The Conference Board publishes the Consumer Confidence Index (R) at 10 a.m. ET on the last Tuesday of every month." 2027-06-29 is the last Tuesday of June 2027. The rule is corroborated for JUNE specifically by three of the publisher's own dated next-release lines, each read off a May edition fetched direct 2026-09-06 at HTTP 200 and verified against its own "Source: May <year> Consumer Confidence Survey" line and "Updated:" date: CCI-May-2023 (Updated 2023-05-30) "The next release is Tuesday, June 27 at 10 AM ET", CCI-May-2024 (2024-05-28) "Tuesday, June 25th", CCI-May-2025 (2025-05-27) "Tuesday, June 24th" -- each of which is the last Tuesday of its June. No June-2027 announcement exists yet, so this is the publisher's rule applied forward against a verified June record rather than a posted date. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the consumer-confidence-2027-05-25 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06), one edition forward on the same chain by which 04-27 proposed this proposer. Proposed for two measured reasons, not bookkeeping. FIRST, it is the chain's next SEP COLLISION TEST and the first one that can actually be run cleanly. The 04-27 lane proved that no CB print can ever meet a projections meeting -- 0 of 28 SEP day-ones is the last Tuesday of its month -- and June 2027 is the sharpest instance yet: the Fed's posted calendar puts the June SEP meeting at 06-08/09*, twenty-one days before this print, so the June edition is the first in the chain whose field window opens AFTER a dot-plot release and closes well before the next meeting. Sourced May cut-off lags run 8/7/8 days (2023-05-22, 2024-05-21, 2025-05-19); if June's are similar a 2027-06-29 panel fields at roughly 06-07 -> 06-21, i.e. it OPENS on the eve of the June decision and collects almost entirely after it. That is the one geometry this series has never had -- a panel whose whole collection period post-dates a projections meeting -- and it is where a Fed-to-sentiment transmission channel would show up if one exists. SECOND, June is the position-in-month rule's opposite case to May: on the last-5-vs-earlier scan run by this proposer, June prints 1 of 9 (XRT narrower late, p=0.0170) against May's 0 of 9, so the pair brackets the flat end of the rule's scope condition. Note for whichever lane takes it: the REAL outstanding test of the 03-30 week-level control rule is DECEMBER, not another flat month -- December is 7 of 9 all narrowing late (AAPL p=0.0007, AMZN p=0.0013, XLF p=0.0013, XRT p=0.0083, VIX p=0.0177, QQQ p=0.0268, XLY p=0.0483), the strongest position signature of any month in the sample, ahead of March's 6 of 9 -- and December is also the one month where the last-Tuesday release rule is REFUTED outright (consumer-confidence-2026-12-22 leg 1, five consecutive editions). Also note that 2027-06-29 carries no Memorial-Day geometry and no FOMC adjacency of its own, and that opex-2027-06-17 sits twelve days before it. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
